STACK & ABOUT

About

I’m a third-year Knowledge Engineering undergraduate at the University of Information Technology (UIT), with experience in web development, AI projects, and hackathons. I have led university group projects, and the part I care about most is identifying real-world problems and evaluating whether a project has business value and the potential to make an impact. My foundation is the MERN stack; I’m now going deeper into Java and Spring Boot, cloud deployment, and AI agent systems.
